The '''Rion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rion/Legends|Rion]].
